-- Bottle Shock
INSERT INTO news (title, slug, excerpt, date, categoryId, coverImageUrl, blocks)
VALUES (
  'Bottle Shock! The Musical',
  'bottle-shock-musical-ccae',
  'Brandon PT Davis served as Assistant Scenic Designer for the world premiere of Bottle Shock! The Musical at California Center for the Arts Escondido, providing drafting and 3D modeling support for Jo Winiarski amazing scenic design that brought a piece of Napa Valley to the stage.',
  '2023-07-23',
  (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'Assistant Scenic Design' LIMIT 1),
  'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/pJwEDvyBKWthNWbv.jpg',
  '[
    {"type":"text","content":"Brandon PT Davis served as Assistant Scenic Designer for the world premiere of Bottle Shock! The Musical at California Center for the Arts Escondido. Working with scenic designer Jo Winiarski, Davis provided drafting and 3D modeling support for an amazing design that brought a piece of Napa Valley wine country to the stage."},
    {"type":"header","content":"The Production"},
    {"type":"text","content":"This world premiere musical tells the story of the famous 1976 Judgment of Paris wine tasting that put California wines on the international map. The production ran July 7-23, 2023 at the Center Theatre."},
    {"type":"team","title":"Creative Team","members":[{"name":"J. Scott Lapp","role":"Director"},{"name":"Jo Winiarski","role":"Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Brandon PT Davis","role":"Assistant Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Zach Blane","role":"Lighting Designer"}]},
    {"type":"link","url":"https://artcenter.org/event/bottleshockthemusical/","text":"Visit California Center for the Arts"}
  ]'
);
